summary: Updates the 6LoWPAN Neighbor Discovery protocol of RFCs 6775 and 8505 with Address-Protected Neighbor Discovery, which protects the owner of an address against theft and impersonation in low-power and lossy networks. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: On a network of small sensors, one gadget could pretend to be another by claiming its address. This document adds a lock so that only the real owner of an address can use it.

questions: how to prevent address theft in 6lowpan
